flagged.location: Definition, expansion and zoom Armijo tests
flagged.evidence: Expansion says “Evaluate $\phi(t)$ and $\phi'(t)$” before comparing $\phi(t)$ with $\phi(0)+c_1t\phi'(0)$; zoom likewise evaluates only $\phi(m)$ and $\phi'(m)$ before its comparison with $\phi(0)$. Although $\phi(0)=f(x)$ is defined, the procedure never states that this baseline is evaluated or supplied as initial data. The Armijo tests therefore lack a specified initial-value evaluation; adding that call or supplying $f(x)$ closes the omission. The current file hash matches the source recorded in batch 70’s in-run finding.
